headline: Hwa Yang Precision teams up with ZEISS to target advanced semiconductor packaging measurement opportunities - Liberty Times Finance
summary: Hwa Yang Precision will work with ZEISS to launch high-precision measurement offerings for advanced semiconductor packaging. The move targets demand from AI and high-performance computing.
why: Advanced packaging measurement supports chip production for AI and high-performance computing, which is a growing part of the semiconductor supply chain.
